parsed.proof:
have h1 : (1:ℝ) < (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < n)
have h2 := Real.logb_pos (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2) h1
have h : (0:ℝ) < 128 * Real.logb 2 (n:ℝ) := by linarith
exact div_le_iff₀ h
parsed.english: The number of variable leaves of f, multiplied by 128·log₂ n, is at least n⁴. This is the same bound with the division cleared.
parsed.why_clearer: It removes the division by 128·log₂ n, which is positive since n ≥ 32, so the bound reads as a plain product inequality.
